title: Lonely Runner Conjecture
exact_target: Does each runner eventually become at least one divided by the number of runners away from every other runner on the unit circular track?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1320 (COMB-002). CC BY 4.0.
Matthieu Rosenfeld, \emph{The lonely runner conjecture holds for eight runners}, arXiv:2509.14111v2 (2025), Section 1, Conjectures 1 and 2 and the paragraph between them.
